pattern: てもしょうがない / てもしかたがない
aliases: temo shou ga nai / temo shikata ga nai
purpose: Say that an action is futile or cannot improve the situation.
keywords: Verb て-form + もしょうがない / もしかたがない
There is no point blaming someone for what is over.
There is no use waiting for someone who is not coming.
There is no use worrying alone, so let us ask for advice.
formation: Verb て-form + もしょうがない / もしかたがない
restrictions: Often encourages acceptance, sometimes with a resigned tone.
mistake: Unlike てしょうがない, this includes も and evaluates the usefulness of an action.
